Active PID absence/query_error remains unavailable rather than zero. The fallback is accepted only after CUDA is initialized, CUDA properties total equals mem_get_info total, total-minus-free is a nonnegative device-wide upper bound no greater than the unchanged 3,000,000,000-byte process cap, and free memory meets the unchanged 6,442,450,944-byte floor. Matched PID bytes are separately capped. No identity check is bypassed.

Physical inventory records all device rows with bounded stdout/stderr, byte length, SHA-256, truncation, return code, and timestamp; N/A metrics parse as null. Active admission requires usable inventory, UUIDs and memory totals for all rows, plus selected-device UUID and memory-total agreement with CUDA within 1 MiB.

Periodic full resource snapshots are atomically persisted before gates. Synchronous full-sample and batch-boundary gate failures and asynchronous poll failures persist resource_abort.json with the failing snapshot before propagating/terminating. CUDA startup failures persist resource_abort.json or the worker-level fit_pair_receipt.json before exit. The worker remains fail-closed.
